README.md.name: README.md
README.md.description: Project setup documentation for a React + TypeScript + Vite template with configuration guidance for ESLint, React Compiler, and recommended linting plugins.

convert.cjs.name: convert.cjs
convert.cjs.description: Build utility script that converts PNG and JPG image files to optimized WebP format using the sharp library with configurable quality settings.

eslint.config.js.name: eslint.config.js
eslint.config.js.description: ESLint configuration for enforcing code quality standards across TypeScript and React files, integrating react-hooks, react-refresh, and typescript-eslint rules.

src/index.css.name: index.css
src/index.css.description: Global CSS stylesheet importing Tailwind CSS and defining root typography, color scheme, and base element styling for the application.

index.html.name: index.html
index.html.description: HTML entry point with typography imports (Barlow Condensed, EB Garamond, etc.), metadata, preloaded assets, and extensive CSS design tokens and animations for a space-themed hero section with astronaut graphics and interactive elements.

tsconfig.app.json.name: tsconfig.app.json
tsconfig.app.json.description: TypeScript compiler configuration for the application source code targeting ES2022 with strict type checking, JSX support, and linting rules for unused locals and parameters.

tsconfig.node.json.name: tsconfig.node.json
tsconfig.node.json.description: TypeScript compiler configuration for Node.js build tools (Vite config) targeting ES2023 with strict mode and node type definitions.

vite.config.ts.name: vite.config.ts
vite.config.ts.description: Vite build configuration that enables Tailwind CSS as a plugin for just-in-time CSS compilation.

src/main.tsx.name: main.tsx
src/main.tsx.description: React application entry point that renders the AppVer2 component into the DOM with StrictMode enabled and imports global CSS.

src/AppVer2.tsx.name: AppVer2.tsx
src/AppVer2.tsx.description: Main React portfolio component featuring Lenis smooth scrolling, project showcase, experience timeline, mobile responsiveness, intersection observer for lazy-loaded projects, and a space-themed hero section with interactive elements.

src/App.tsx.name: App.tsx
src/App.tsx.description: A portfolio/personal website landing page component that renders a hero section with smooth scrolling (Lenis), modal overlays for About and Contact sections, and displays professional experiences and projects. Manages global styles, smooth scroll initialization, and navigation state between home/about/contact views.
